cases.name: explicitly_cancelled
cases.argsGo: func() context.Context { c, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background()); cancel(); return c }()

cases.name: child_of_uncancelled_parent
cases.argsGo: func() context.Context { c, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background()); _ = cancel; return c }()

cases.name: child_of_cancelled_parent
cases.argsGo: func() context.Context { parent, pcancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background()); pcancel(); child, _ := context.WithCancel(parent); return child }()
